# Janii

> Archived experiment. Janii was a free public-beta Windows app for wedding photographers (released 4 Sep 2026). It is closed: no support, no further development, not for client work. The source code has not been published.

## Why it was closed

On one wedding, against one person's picks made as the client (a wedding Janii was tuned on), Janii matched 44.4 % of the picks, against 43.8 % by sharpness alone and 39.9 % by chance.

## Download

The beta ZIP stays on GitHub for existing users: https://github.com/AndryRoby/janii/releases/latest. It was built on 4 Sep 2026, includes the Python engine as of that day under all-rights-reserved terms, and does not include later changes.
